leadStory: Alexis Mac Allister, speaking to ESPN from the Argentina camp, says there is 'no firm decision yet' on his Liverpool future, two years from the end of a contract the club told him this month it was not in a position to extend, after Szoboszlai and Gravenberch both signed new deals.
note: No Track 2 request this edition. The lead is a contract stand-off delivered as an interview, and the second surface is Jamie Carragher on a podcast arguing Florian Wirtz should be dropped for Manchester City. Neither is a photographable moment, and the skill caps queueing at one genuinely visual moment per edition. Antigravity should take no action. If a plate is wanted for a future edition, the standing candidate remains Jeremy Jacquet, 21, the best player on the field on the day France called him up for the first time.
